newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai money brokerage trades more in October.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai money brokerage trades more in October.

text.p: The People's Bank of China's Shanghai Short-term Fund Financing Centre traded 25.05 billion yuan in October, an increase of 53.44 percent from September, the Shanghai Securities News said on Thursday.
The centre, the city's main money brokerage, cut interest rates by 0.012 percentage points in October due to a surplus of short-term money caused by an increase in bank deposits.
The supply of funds through the centre was sufficient, the newspaper said.
Meanwhile, money demand from other areas had increased, helping to activate the centre's business, it said.
The centre is the most active member on China's renminbi interbank market, launched early this year to facilitate interbank borrowing and lending of short-term money.
